settings.voiceStyle: Natural Thai sibling dialogue. One speaker per scene. Spoken names are ซีชาร์ป and อาริ only. Never pronounce the letters A-R-I.
settings.customCharacterStyle: Two consistent stylized East Asian boy game avatars with fair/light skin and dark-brown hair. The older brother is taller with a locked rounded-square face and neat side-swept hair; the younger brother is shorter with a locked rounder face, slightly larger dark-brown eyes and fluffy-front hair. Keep the exact same faces, skin tone, hair silhouettes, outfits, props and body proportions in every scene. Never render character names or readable text above their heads.
settings.visualStyle: Bright family-friendly Roblox-style adventure world, colorful obstacle geometry, cheerful daylight and arcade glow, clean cinematic composition, no dark horror, no realistic injury, no official logos, no copied UI, no photorealism, no floating names, no usernames, no overhead labels, no chat bubbles, no subtitles, no captions, no health bars.
settings.customProjectStructure: Vertical 9:16, 16 scenes x 8 seconds. One level per episode and complete the level in this episode. One main action and one primary camera move per scene. One speaking character per scene. Use previous generated scene image as primary continuity reference from scene 2 onward when location/time/action continues. Preserve exact faces, skin tone, outfits, height relationship, screen direction, obstacle state and lighting.
settings.customVisualStyle: Colorful stylized game cinematic with smooth scene-to-scene continuity, varied camera angles, playful physics and strong visual storytelling. Characters must never reset identity between scenes.

movie.mainStoryPrompt: Two stylized East Asian brothers with fair/light skin enter a bright Beginner Obby through a mysterious portal. The older brother is taller, calm and protective; the younger brother is shorter, observant and quick. Their exact faces and outfits must remain identical across all 16 scenes. Use one speaker per scene and short Thai dialogue. The younger brother's spoken name is always อาริ and the older brother's spoken name is ซีชาร์ป. Do not render character names, usernames or any overhead UI text. From scene 2 onward use the immediately previous generated scene image as continuity reference whenever the action continues. Complete the obstacle level and return safely by the end of the episode.
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่ Beginner Obby ผ่าน Portal ลึกลับ ช่วยกันผ่านแพลตฟอร์ม แผ่นสี สะพานหาย ปุ่มแดง ใบพัดหมุน และด่านสุดท้าย ก่อนกลับ Lobby ได้สำเร็จ
